author: sproul
content: the problem is that the LMD vote is still part of the slashing, so you might be somewhat constrained in how quickly you can slash the attacker if you have to slash lots of unique pairs of AttestationData

author: potuz
content: I understand but still given the aggregation factor I believe this is minor. At any rate I believe the right way of fixing this and a bunch of other issues is to make lmd/ffg compatibility be Gloas aware. That is, consider payload content as part of the target. A vote for slot 33 that built on 32 full should be finalizing 32 full and not 32 empty. Slashing invalid attestations has always been useless anyway (as in they can't finalize another chain) so just ditching must attestations with payload content is enough

author: m.kalinin
content: From my ancient computations, an attester slashing can be up to 488 kB (uncompressed). We can increase a number of slashings up to 2 maybe, 1 mB beacon block should not cause big problems. Increasing this number to 4 can be problematic but might still be fine. Note that with decoupled consensus slashing will change
